decisions.reason: Locates all partial/runningCalls/turnEnds reads, routes them through the documented chat legacy projection (useChat(chat => chat?.legacy...), views.get('chat')?.legacy) and notes later migration to the owning timeline API — a supported direct migration with the compatibility option explained.

Locates running at Pet.tsx:18-19, assigns it to the useSession lifecycle seat explicitly outside the chat legacy projection, prescribes keeping useSession(s => s?.running ?? false), and never claims the existing call must be renamed.

Locates the removed dsh-client-runtime imports and package.json client.inject entry, repoints Context as ClientContext to scoped @deepseek-ai/cordis, moves snapshot types to their owning ui-chat package, and does not claim cordis exports snapshot types.

Locates the scoped slots.register call, preserves runtime inject=['slots','conversation','locale'] and the scoped wait, attributes the slots declaration to the ui-renderer owner via Context augmentations, and preserves slot name and lifetime.

Ties each located change to full DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 (plus A1-25 for package removal) with per-row reasoning, and clearly separates projection-supported content reads from immediate type/inject/lifecycle changes.
